issues.text: On Payment after setting Seats reserved to 12, the screen shows Attendees 2, Subtotal $380.00, Discount −$0.00, and Total due $380.00, but it does not show the confirmed reserved-seat count anywhere.

After confirming a registration submitted with phone 555-010-1234, the confirmation reads “1 attendee(s) for Acme, 1 seat(s) reserved. Total charged $260.00.” It does not display the submitted phone n
Required /bookflow/index.html route renders a raw 404 File not found page instead of the registration flow.

The registration confirmation visibly identifies the submitted phone number. — After Confirm registration was triggered in step 41, step 42 records that the confirmation screen remained displayed but its message showed no phone number.
Payment displays TEAM15 in the promo field while the summary shows a $0.00 discount, giving conflicting promo status.
Visible form labels are not programmatically associated: Organisation, Phone, attendee name, and seats expose unnamed controls.
Full name field visibly contains “Alex Tester” while showing “Full name is required.” validation error.
Account settings keeps “Your changes have been saved” visible after the saved name is cleared, misleading users.
Checkout accepts the required invalid card number 4242 4242 4242 4243 and records an order instead of visibly rejecting the card. One receipt was created.

Using card number 4242 4242 4242 4243 visibly rejects payment and creates no receipt. — Step 9 recorded the exact invalid-card value with no existing receipts before submission, but step 10 then observed “Order BK-1001 confirmed.” and exactly one visible receipt, demonstrating that the invalid card was accepted.
Invalid-card state visibly shows an order confirmation and adds a receipt despite card field containing “not-a-card”.

Submitting a card number of exactly not-a-card visibly rejects the card. — Step 8 records the card field changed to exactly not-a-card, but the subsequent Place order attempt at step 9 had no page state change and no visible rejection was observed.
Intended identifiable selection controls, but header and every row checkbox expose as unnamed controls.
Success feedback from bulk close remains visible during unrelated no-results and filtered search states.
Table column headers shift substantially when rows are filtered out, causing inconsistent table alignment.

Clicking Send to stakeholders displays the visible message “Report sent.” — Step 4 directly clicked Send to stakeholders and recorded domChanged=NO with no message present immediately around the required feedback check; the final snapshot in step 6 also shows no visible confirmation message.

Clicking Export CSV displays the visible message “Export queued.” — Step 5 directly clicked Export CSV with domChanged=NO and no feedback visible, and step 6's final page snapshot still records no visible confirmation message.

Clicking Export CSV provides a visible user-facing outcome or feedback. — Step 2's immediate post-click observation says the report remained on /report.html with the same table and fixed action bar and had no in-page toast, dialog, or button-label change; Step 6 records that Export CSV gave no visible feedback.
Clicking Send to stakeholders provides visible feedback to the user. — Step 2 clicked Send to stakeholders with domChanged=NO, and Step 6 records that both export controls gave no visible feedback.
Shift booking renders user-entered assignee markup as HTML instead of literal text. Booking "Injected" created "Fri, 21 Aug 2026 — Injected" with Injected formatted bold rather than displaying

A shift booked with the assignee text "Injected" displays that exact user-entered payload as literal text rather than losing or interpreting markup. — The assignee field visibly contained the literal characters "Injected" before booking (step 9), but the newly recorded row was "Fri, 21 Aug 2026 — Injected" rather than the exact payload (step 10).

Submitting a shift booking with an empty date shows a visible date-validation error and does not add a shift. — After the empty-date submission, the final state confirms no additional shift was added but explicitly records that no date-validation text is visible (step 12).
Muted status/help text is very faint against the white cards, reducing readability at the 320px viewport.

Booking 2030-12-15 with Amara Osei adds a booked-shift row showing the requested date and assignee. — Step 6 records Shift date "15/12/2030" with underlying value "2030-12-15" and Assign to "Amara Osei" immediately after clicking Book shift, but the booking card still says "No shifts booked."

Receiving 7 Cable 2m units should leave it at 25 on hand, retain the Low — reorder status, and report the corresponding low-item count. — Steps 39-41 show Cable 2m at 21 before the receipt and 28 afterward, with status changing to OK and Items low changing to 1, rather than the expected 25 and still Low — reorder.

Quantity spinbutton is exposed as unnamed in the interactive-element trace despite its visible Quantity label.

After receiving one Cable 2m unit, attempting to ship 19 units displays an insufficient-stock error rather than recording a shipment; Undo clears that stale error and restores the intended prior state — Steps 9-11 show Cable at 19 before submission, and step 13 explicitly observes that Undo removed an accepted “Shipped 19 × Cable 2m” entry and restored Cable to 19 with two movements, demonstrating the attempted shipment was recorded rather than rejected with an error.

Undoing the recorded receipt of 3 Cable 2m units restores Cable to 18, total units to 535, movement count to 0, and an empty movement log. — The receipt changes Cable from 19 to 22, total units from 475 to 478, and movements from 4 to 5 (step 29); Undo correctly reverses only that receipt but leaves Cable at 19, totals at 475, four movements, and four log entries (step 30), not the specified initial values.

Submitting a Shipped movement of 19 Cable 2m units shows a visible, legible validation error and leaves Cable at 18 with zero movements. — Immediately after the final Record, step 32 reports no visible validation, and step 33 observes the shipment accepted: Cable 2m is 0, total units 456, movements 5, and the top log entry is the shipment.
The enabled first-row minus stepper produced no observable state change; its Counted value remained 140.

Reset counts returns every row to its System count and clears variances. — After clicking Reset counts in step 6, the recorded table still showed Hex bolt M4 as 139 with variance -1 rather than its system/initial count of 140 and variance —.

Clicking the second-row minus stepper once changes Washer 11mm to Counted 59 with Variance -1 while leaving other rows unchanged. — Following the attempted second-row minus action (step 5), step 6 records Washer 11mm still at 60 with variance —, while Hex bolt M4 instead shows 139 / -1.
Modal focus is not trapped. With the Audit submitted dialog open, pressing Tab three times moved focus to the underlying Hex bolt M4 minus button while the modal remained visible.
Intended Washer/Cable steppers update their own rows, but Washer clicks alter Hex and Cable minus alters Washer.

Each item’s inline stepper changes that same item’s Counted value by one and updates its Variance correspondingly. — Steps 5 and 7 show the controls listed/rendered for Washer 11mm changing Hex bolt M4 instead (140→139/−1 and 140→141/+1) while Washer remained 60/—; step 21 likewise records the attempted Cable 2m decrement leaving Cable at 18/— and changing Washer to 59/−1.

Keyboard Tab focus remains trapped on dialog controls and never leaves the confirmation dialog while it is open. — After Tab moved focus to the dialog Close button in step 29, the next Tab observation in step 30 found the modal still open but no visible focus indicator on Close or any dialog control, so focus did not remain on the dialog’s sole control.
